description: This Swift source file defines a user interface view for managing permissions and location settings within a macOS application, utilizing SwiftUI. It includes components for displaying permission statuses, handling user interactions for granting permissions, and managing location access configurations.

classes.name: PermissionsSettings
classes.description: Main view component for displaying and managing app permissions and settings.

classes.name: LocationAccessSettings
classes.description: Private subview for configuring location access and mode.

classes.name: PermissionStatusList
classes.description: View displaying the list of permissions and their current status, with refresh capability.

classes.name: PermissionRow
classes.description: Individual row representing a specific permission, with actions for granting access.

methods.name: requestLocationAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously requests location permission based on the selected mode.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the permission request process for a specific capability.

methods.name: refreshStatusTransitions
methods.description: Refreshes permission statuses with delays to account for system settling times.
